signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no noise; the configured-but-empty test script is the only clutter.

findings.issue: 'ng test' script points at a unit-test builder with zero spec files — it errors ('No test files found') or runs an empty suite; the whole Vitest toolchain is scaffolded but unused
findings.suggestion: Write Vitest specs for util.ts, catalog.service.ts pure functions, move-table sorting and home-page pagination, or remove the dead script and deps

findings.issue: Catalog derivation (types in slot order from type resources, generation mapping, alternate-form exclusion) is the app's core data transformation and has no tests
findings.suggestion: Unit-test load()/pokemonRefsToCards with a small fixture catalog; assert type slot order, dedupe and id>=10000 exclusion

findings.issue: idFromUrl returning NaN silently yields species with missing types/generation instead of an error; latestEnglishFlavor and humanize edge cases equally unguarded
findings.suggestion: Table-driven tests for util.ts: NaN URLs, nidoran-f, ho-oh, empty '-' segments, non-English-last flavor entries

findings.issue: Nulls-last-in-both-directions is a subtle early-return-before-direction-flip; any refactor of compareValues can silently break descending sorts, and aria-sort/toggle logic is untested
findings.suggestion: Unit tests asserting ascending and descending orderings with missing power/accuracy values and the aria-sort attribute

findings.issue: Filtering, 48-per-page slicing and page clamping (Math.min with parseInt fallback) are classic off-by-one territory with zero coverage
findings.suggestion: Component or extracted-function tests for filter combinations, boundary pages, and out-of-range ?page values

findings.issue: URL state rules (omit empty/default params, reset to page 1 on filter change) and the 200 ms debounce are only covered by the external acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Test applyFilters/pageParams param omission and reset behavior; assert the debounced navigation

findings.issue: Promise cache failure eviction and normalize() trailing-slash handling are untested; a regression caches rejected promises or misses the cache
findings.suggestion: Unit tests with a stubbed HttpClient: failure then success refetches; 'pokemon/25', 'pokemon/25/', 'type?limit=100' normalize to the same cache keys

findings.issue: Default game selection (highest order), method table ordering and level-up sort (level then name) in pokemonResolver are unguarded against refactor regressions
findings.suggestion: Resolver-level tests with a small moves fixture, including a ?game= override and an invalid one

findings.issue: Error/not-found paths (resolver null → NotFound render, RESPONSE_INIT 404 status in not-found.component.ts:14) are untested
findings.suggestion: Test that a failing primary fetch yields the not-found view and a 404 status on the server

findings.issue: Debounce timer is never cleared on destroy, so a pending search can fire navigation after the component is gone
findings.suggestion: Register cleanup with DestroyRef and add a component test that unmounts mid-debounce

summary: The app ships no tests of its own despite scaffolding the entire Vitest toolchain, leaving a `ng test` script that can't do anything useful. Its riskiest code — catalog derivation, name/flavor text formatting, filtering/pagination, and multi-column sorting with nulls-last semantics — is guarded only by acceptance tests the team doesn't own, so a data-layer refactor would be flying blind. The good news is that the logic is factored into pure functions and resolvers, so adding meaningful unit tests would be cheap; the agent simply didn't.
